title: Amending heavy vehicle access permits
summary: This page provides information on how to amend, cancel, or replace heavy vehicle access permits through the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR).
intro:
Heavy vehicle access permits can be amended through the National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NVHR).

To apply for an amendment your permit must be valid (not expired).

You can also cancel a permit through the NHVR, or replace one if it's been defaced, destroyed, lost or stolen.

To apply for an amendment log in to your NHVR Go account.
who_can_apply: The permit must be valid (not expired) to apply for an amendment.
what_you_need: An NHVR Go account to log in to

faqs.a: To apply for an amendment, you must log in to your NHVR Go account.
